# reports/ (Inventory, sales, cash + communication)

Inventory / sales-analysis / cash-movement / comms reports. Complement the 25+ flat `reports-*.ts` files in the parent dir (which hold GL reports — TB, BS, IS, VAT return).

## Endpoints
- `GET /api/accounting/reports/cash-movement` — bank transactions by account, inflows/outflows/net/running balance for date range
- `GET /api/accounting/reports/customer-communication` — log with `?customer_id=&from=&to=&status=&page=&limit=`; `?format=csv` streams CSV
- `GET /api/accounting/reports/item-listing` — master list with category, pricing, stock
- `GET /api/accounting/reports/item-movement` — in/out/adjustments per item + running balance
- `GET /api/accounting/reports/item-quantities` — on-hand quantities + min-stock alerts
- `GET /api/accounting/reports/item-valuation` — qty × cost by item, totals by category
- `GET /api/accounting/reports/sales-by-customer` — grouped summary for date range
- `GET /api/accounting/reports/sales-by-item`
- `GET /api/accounting/reports/purchases-by-supplier`
- `GET /api/accounting/reports/purchases-by-item`

## Auth
- `cash-movement`, `customer-communication`: `withAuth(withErrorHandler(handler))` — no `withWriteAccess`
- All item / stock / sales / purchases reports: `withAuth(withErrorHandler(withWriteAccess(handler)))` — GETs pass through untouched, still require `owner|admin|manager`

## Request / Response
- All JSON responses: `apiResponse.success` — clients unwrap `json.data`
- `customer-communication` with `?format=csv` streams CSV directly (bypasses `apiResponse`) — do NOT unwrap
- Date range params typically `from` / `to` (`YYYY-MM-DD`) — naming not fully standardised, verify per endpoint

## Business rules
- All routes read-only — no mutations in this subtree
- Item stock reports read from `items` and `stock_adjustments` — NOT GL-based
- `purchases-by-*` / `sales-by-*` reports use `gl_account_id` (fixed in custom reports 2026-04-20)
- AFS overview 404s on Balance Sheet / Income Statement fixed 2026-04-21

## Related files
- `src/modules/accounting/services/reports/*` — inventory, sales, purchases, cash, comms
